description: Find upcoming author events listed on BookGather: book signings, readings, library and bookstore author events, book festivals and online author talks. Filter by keywords, place and date. Returns title, date (UTC), location, cost and the event page link.

from_date.description: Earliest date, YYYY-MM-DD. Defaults to today.

location.description: City, state code or venue name to match in the event location, e.g. 'Dallas', 'WA', 'Seattle'.

query.description: Keywords that must all appear in the title, description or tags, e.g. 'romance signing' or an author's name.

name: search_events
title: Search author events
